ratings.reasons: Every yin break stays open now: the halves drift outward by uneven amounts and dim, so the ranks go ragged (army-48) while the hexagram stays readable as 7, and the one whole, brighter line in the second place stands out as the general. The yin lines falling back into straight ranks nearest first reads as order around one strong leader, and everything stays inside the frame.

The bottom line rises most and the two yin lines above it crowd together while the top line and the gap between the trigrams hold still (nourish-57): a lower jaw working under a still upper jaw, thunder moving below the mountain. It no longer looks like 11's meeting, and the change from open to crowded is visible at phone size.
